title: Run 27 attempt record v1
description: Write-once record created when an attempt begins. Its terminal state is not stored here: it is carried by the write-once marker files merged.json, failed.json, interrupted.json, and abandoned.json beside it, so an attempt's history can never be rewritten in place.

parent_attempt_id.description: Set when this attempt was created by resuming an interrupted, failed, or abandoned parent. A resumed attempt is always a new child, never a reopened parent.

predecessor_receipt_digests.description: Predecessor receipt digests observed when the attempt was created, so a resumed child is provably bound to current predecessor state.

evidence_dir.description: Attempt-scoped, write-once log directory, relative to the state directory.
